text: Lower taxes matter more than extra spending on public services.
Free markets allocate resources better than governments do.
Businesses should be free to set wages without government interference.
Privatising public utilities makes them more efficient.
The government should guarantee a minimum income for every adult.
Workers should have seats on the boards of large companies.
Public transport should be paid for by taxes and free to use.
Large inheritances should be heavily taxed.
Protesters who block roads should face prison sentences.
The government should be able to monitor online communications to prevent crime.
Schools should teach children to respect traditional values.
Prisoners serving long sentences should not be released early for good behaviour.
Same-sex couples should have the same right to adopt children as other couples.
Recreational cannabis should be legal for adults.
Assisted dying should be legal for terminally ill adults.
Sex work between consenting adults should be legal.
